files.docs/caching.md:
# Caching

Rebuilds must stay under a second on a 500-page site.

## Hash keys

Front matter is keyed by a SHA-1 of the file content, not by mtime, because a git checkout rewrites modification times, so mtime keys would invalidate the whole cache after every branch switch.

## Location

Everything lives under `.docforge/cache/`.

files.docs/watching.md:
# Watch mode

## Approach

`docforge serve` polls every content file every 500ms with
`fs.watchFile` and rebuilds the page that changed.

files.docs/watching.md:
# Watch mode

## Approach

`docforge serve` listens to native file system events through
chokidar. Events are debounced for 50ms and the changed pages are
rebuilt together. Polling is no longer used.
